title: Introduction to AI Safety, Ethics, and Society

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing statistical metrics such as equalized odds (false positive and false negative rates) and calibration in predictive systems like criminal justice risk assessments (e.g., COMPAS) and healthcare allocation algorithms.

Analyzing model decisions for penalties associated with implicit gender signals (e.g., female-associated words in resume screening), examining image misclassification based on gender stereotypes, and evaluating stereotypical associations in language models (e.g., word analogies).
Comparing the flagging rates of content moderation systems when processing identical negative comments directed at different political affiliations (e.g., conservatives vs. liberals).
Assessing disparities in how content moderation systems classify negative comments directed toward different religious identities.
Measuring disparities in the classification and moderation of text directed at different nationalities.
